At start of player phase or enemy phase, grants【Atk Liberate】,【Spd Liberate】, and 【Creation Pulse】to unit and allies within 2 spaces of unit for 1 turn.
Grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+15 to unit, unit deals +25 damage (excluding area-of-effect Specials), reduces damage from foe's attacks by 15 (excluding area-of-effect Specials), and neutralizes effects that guarantee foe's follow-up attacks and effects that prevent unit's follow-up attacks during combat, and also, if unit's Spd > foe's Spd or unit's Res > foe's Res, unit attacks twice during combat.
Effect:【Dagger ７】
【Atk Liberate】
Grants bonus to Atk during combat = number of Bonus effects active on unit, excluding stat bonuses, + 4 (max 8).
【Spd Liberate】
Grants bonus to Spd during combat = number of Bonus effects active on unit, excluding stat bonuses, + 4 (max 8).
【Creation Pulse】
If unit's attack can trigger unit's Special, grants Special cooldown count-X before unit's first attack during combat (X = number of Penalty effects active on foe, excluding stat penalties; max 2). (For 1 turn.)
【Dagger ７】
After combat, if unit attacked, inflicts Def/Res-７ on target and foes within 2 spaces of target through their next actions.

special.d:
When Special triggers, boosts damage dealt by 200%.
At start of turn, grants Special cooldown count-1 to unit.
Reduces damage from foe's first attack by 40% during combat ("first attack" normally means only the first strike; for effects that grant "unit attacks twice," it means the first and second strikes).

b.d:
Unit can move through foes' spaces.
Unit can move to a space within 2 spaces of any ally within 2 spaces of unit.
At start of turn and after unit acts (if Canto triggers, after Canto), inflicts Spd/Def-7, 【Share Spoils+】, and【Panic】on closest foes and foes within 2 spaces of those foes through their next actions.
The effects of【Share Spoils+】inflicted on foes once per turn for the entire map can be triggered up to twice per turn for the entire map (only highest value applied; does not stack).
Inflicts Atk/Spd/Def-5 on foe, inflicts Spd/Def-X on foe (X = highest total penalties among target and foes within 2 spaces of target), and reduces damage from foe's attacks by 20% of the greater of unit's Spd or Res during combat (excluding area-of-effect Specials).
【Share Spoils+】
Inflicts Atk/Spd/Def/Res-5 on unit during combat and neutralizes "reduces damage by X%" effects from unit's non-Special skills (excluding area-of-effect Specials).
Once per turn for the entire map, if foe initiates combat and if unit is defeated in combat, grants another action to that foe after combat (this effect has priority over other similar effects aside from Share Spoils; if this status and Share Spoils are both active at the same time, they are both treated as having been triggered; other similar effects aside from Share Spoils are treated as not having triggered).
【Panic】
Converts bonuses on unit into penalties.

【Canto (１)】
After an attack, Assist skill, or structure destruction, unit can move １ space(s).
(Unit moves according to movement type. Once per turn. Cannot attack or assist. Only highest value applied. Does not stack. After moving, if a skill that grants another action would be triggered (like with Galeforce), Canto will trigger after the granted action. Unit's base movement has no effect on movement granted. Cannot warp (using skills like Wings of Mercy) a distance greater than unit would be able to move with normal Canto movement.)
【Distant Swap】
Range = 2. Unit and target ally swap spaces.
